title: Chapter 436 The Sword God Comes To Visit
content:
Chapter 436 The Sword God Comes To Visit

The beggar looked at Wang Shuo, then shook his head and muttered, "I don't drink alcohol, I don't eat meat, I eat steamed buns."

Wang Shuo looked at the beggar in surprise. He must have been an ordinary person before to have such skills.

"Okay, let's eat steamed buns. Follow me."

Wang Shuo took him to the canteen in the military camp and ordered someone to bring a steamer of big white steamed buns.

"Eat! There are enough steamed buns."

The beggar immediately started eating with a smile.

Before he finished one, he took another one and stuffed it into his mouth in big mouthfuls, looking like he hadn't eaten for many days.

He choked after eating a few bites.

Wang Shuo ordered someone to bring some water.

Just when the beggar was eating happily, Wang Shuo suddenly attacked and punched the beggar in the face.

Wang Shuo wanted to test the beggar's true strength.

Just when the fist was about to approach the beggar's nose, the beggar grabbed Wang Shuo's fist with a big hand.

Although Wang Shuo just made a random attack, it was a sneak attack, but the beggar's reaction still surprised Wang Shuo greatly.

If converted into agility value, the beggar's agility is not inferior to Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo knew it in his heart and joked: "A fly just flew by, eat slowly."

Wang Shuo took the beggar in the barracks and gave him a place to stay.

At the same time, Wang Shuo also sent some soldiers to investigate the origin of the beggar.

After all, a strange master sneaked into the city, Wang Shuo was still a little worried.

A few days later, Wang Shuo got the news that no one knew where the beggar came from.

Wang Shuo even asked Dongfang Ke, who just said that he came from the direction of the Central Dynasty.

He didn't know more specifics.

After the investigation was fruitless, Wang Shuo ignored the matter.

Because something more important happened at this time.

The Demon King broke through to the strongest king.

This matter was like a big earthquake.

The forces near Tiexue Ridge suddenly became nervous.

Wang Shuo was also ready to retreat to the Great Wall at any time.

As for advancing and retreating with Dongfang Ke and Wang Zhu, as long as his brain was not broken, he would definitely not do it.

Just when Wang Shuo was uneasy, a mysterious master suddenly came to Guancheng.

This person called himself the Sword God.

He started a killing spree in Guancheng.

Wang Shuo heard someone making trouble at the city gate and rushed over immediately.

Feeling the other party's breath, Wang Shuo was horrified.

Damn, this is the breath of the king.

The Demon King did not see it, but met the Sword God first.

Wang Shuo secretly said that it was bad luck and ran away immediately.

But he was soon stopped.

The Sword God was originally looking for the second prince, but when Wang Shuo approached, he seemed to feel the breath of the Ice Phoenix Emperor.

"Boy, have you seen an ice bird?"

Wang Shuo's heart trembled, and he thought to himself that it was bad, and the real owner came to the door.

Wang Shuo wanted to deny it, but facing the Sword God, he would probably be arrested even if he denied it.

Without nonsense, Wang Shuo ran away.

This clearly told the Sword God that he was trying to cover up his crime!

But Wang Shuo had no better solution.

The Sword God sneered.

He blocked Wang Shuo in a moment.

Wang Shuo immediately took out the Shura Demon-Breaking Spear and surrendered, which was not Wang Shuo's style.

"Oh, it's still a Shura." The Sword God sneered, "It's a pity that the level is a little low."

As he said that, he rushed towards Wang Shuo and stretched out his right hand to catch Wang Shuo.

He did not use a long sword. He didn't take a character like Wang Shuo seriously.

Facing the casual grab of the Sword God, Wang Shuo did not dare to neglect it at all. He immediately launched a big move.

"Flying Dragon in the Sky".

A giant dragon pounced on the Sword God with its fangs and claws.

Barely resisted the attack of the Sword God.
